name: SOX-Player
description: Play sounds on a host machine. Comes with a simple HTTP API for playing back audio on demand from a remote process or system. Designed for use in playing pre-recorded audio notifications for home automation software (openHAB).

paths.name: Sound Files
paths.description: Path to the folder containing sound files to be played

variables.name: Deny File Listing
variables.description: If true, prevents listing of available sound files via the API

variables.name: Internal API Port
variables.description: Internal port the API listens on. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Internal Sound Files Location
variables.description: Internal path to the sound files location. Not recommended to change.

devices.name: Output Device
devices.description: Path to the output sound device (e.g., /dev/snd)
